name: database-navigator-expert
description: Expert guidance on using the Database Navigator (TDA_DatabaseNavigator) well — reading object roles and column flags, choosing declared over inferred joins, respecting masked personal data, and turning catalog facts into correct SQL.
author: Uderia
use_cases: Deciding whether to describe a table before writing SQL
Reading a table's inferred role (fact, dimension, bridge, lookup) to plan a query
Choosing declared foreign keys over inferred join candidates
Handling columns flagged as personal data or text-stored dates
Turning a catalog description into a precise, small first query
Running an agent's own read-only query well: aggregate in SQL, respect the row bound and the source's dialect
